description: This file defines an API endpoint class for managing employee supervisor data within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It provides functionality to list supervisors related to an employee, with parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class extends a generic Endpoint and implements the CrudEndpoint interface but only supports the 'getAll' method (listing supervisors).

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: API class for listing employee supervisors with filtering and pagination capabilities. Extends Endpoint and implements CRUD interface, but only 'getAll' is functional.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of supervisors for an employee, applying filters such as employee number and name or ID, and returning the supervisors along with the total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method's query parameters, including optional employee number and name/ID filter.
